nom: Pacifica Glow Baby Brightening Peel Pads 10% AHA + BHA

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the product cuts excess oil and shrinks the look of pores, with one describing it as not harsh compared to physical exfoliants and another using it specifically on the T-zone for oil control.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: several say it leaves skin less dry, smoother and no longer flaky over time, but one with dry skin in a dry climate reports large dry patches and peeling fingers, calling it too strong.
segments.combination: A reviewer with normal-to-combination skin reports a severe breakout with blisters and an itchy rash after first use, while another with normal-to-oily skin reports brighter skin with no stickiness using it daily.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided group: several with self-described very or extremely sensitive skin report no irritation and strong brightening/smoothing results, while multiple others with sensitive skin report burning, stinging, redness, or raised itchy blisters severe enough to require medical treatment.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s–60s) generally report brightening, firmer or smoother skin and reduced signs of aging, though one 50+ reviewer with slightly oily skin reports a sticky film and no benefit.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging concerns report smoother, firmer, plumper skin and fading wrinkles or sagging over weeks of use; no dissent noted on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Some reviewers report the pads reduce flakiness and leave skin more hydrated-looking over time; others report the product is drying, causing dry patches, peeling, or requiring reduced frequency of use to avoid dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report reduced redness and more even tone with continued use; however, several others report the product itself triggers new redness, burning, or a rashy reaction, particularly on first use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer explicitly ties results to barrier condition, noting the pads do not burn when her skin barrier is healthy but sting slightly when it is compromised; several others describe reactions (blisters, rash) suggesting barrier disruption.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible fading of hyperpigmentation, melasma, sun spots, and discoloration (including on chest) within weeks to two months of use; no negative reports specific to spot-fading are noted.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report cleared breakouts, faster healing of pimples, and reduced acne overnight to within days; a few dissent, reporting the product left residue, felt clogging, and caused increased breakouts over months of use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or congested skin report smaller-looking pores and a mattifying, oil-removing effect after wiping the pads over the face; no dissent found for this concern.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or heavy residue left on skin
Effective on body for ingrown hairs

extraits.titre: This will make you break out !
extraits.texte: I tried this BHA pad, I use several AHA/BHA products. But wanted an easy-use pad instead of the cream. After the 1st use, my face broke out into blisters with an itchy rash. I had to go to my doctors and get a steroid patch and Itching cream to cure it. It's been a week and it is still not gone away. I have normal to combination skin. And never once has anything ever done this to my face. Buyer BEWARE

extraits.titre: Great price, but not for dry skin
extraits.texte: I have rather dry skin, I live in a dry climate, and perhaps the mix of that just caused my skin to have huge dry patches on my cheeks. This was the only new product I've added into my regimen, so its gotta be this. So bummed! The price was great, but not for dry skin. It also caused my fingers to peel! it is crazy, I guess it's too strong for me.

extraits.titre: Love the Results, Not the Smell
extraits.texte: As a 45/F W/slightly oily, mild rosacea on cheeks, easily turns red, sensitive skin, I was leery to try these on my face. I had used a similar product years ago by Dr. Dennis Gross, with beautiful results, so I took the plunge. I'm very impressed with the results! I use 1-2 pads, a quick sweep over the face, focus on nose, cover neck/décolleté as well. The next morning I wake up with soft, evenly toned, happy skin. I personally go every other day with this treatment. I would give this five stars, but the smell is not very pleasant. I'm happy that it wears off quickly, but the initial smell is like a "sour" orange popsicle. I'm ready to try a few other skincare products by Pacifica.

I use this at night a couple times per week and wake up with smooth, glowing skin each time. Although my skin is very sensitive and it stings slightly with application, I also wake up with less redness and overall a more even skin tone. 10/10 for me, especially for the price.

I have extremely sensitive skin - I break down in hives often, my skin becomes angry, red and flakes with new products, etc. So, I was hesitant to invest in these pads. However, that hesitation turned to pure joy, as I have watched my skin look years younger with only a few weeks of use! And, I haven't had any problems tolerating this perfect product! As a middle-aged woman, I deal with discoloration, sagging skin and wrinkles. I use these every other night. My skin tone is evening, my skin is much softer and plumper and my wrinkles seem to be melting away! I couldn't be more thrilled with a skin care product - and, I am a total make-up and skin care junkie! Plus, this product is vegan and cruelty free - a total holy grail for the skin and the environment! I will be using these for life!

I've been using these for over a year and they are AMAZING!!! I am almost 40 with acne prone clogged skin and these give me a glow like I had in my youth plus keep my acne at bay. I'm obsessed and I hope they never stop making these.

extraits.titre: Leaves residue and breaks me out
extraits.texte: I usually love pacifica and was excited to try this as a more affordable alternative to the first aid beauty pads but its been about 3 months of using this and I find its kind of sticky or feels heavy and clogging and ive been breaking out more than ever. Not for me.
